description: This file defines a Java interface 'BackgroundStreamingConfig' that specifies configuration methods for background streaming behavior, including enabling/disabling, quiet period duration, number of kept events, and retrieving the configuration in HOCON format.

classes.name: BackgroundStreamingConfig
classes.description: Interface for configuring background streaming features such as enabling status, quiet period duration, number of events to keep, and retrieving the configuration in HOCON format.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether background streaming is turned on.

methods.name: getQuietPeriod
methods.description: Returns the duration of the quiet period between streams.

methods.name: getKeptEvents
methods.description: Returns the number of events to keep in the actor state.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration in HOCON format.
